counter.label: deaths a year per 1,000 soldiers at home, against 9.2 for men of their ages

connections.why: William Farr, who worked out the army's death rates against civilians' for Nightingale and the Royal Commission, had the General Register Office order a Scheutz difference engine in 1857 to compute and print the English Life Table.
